entries.reason: No safe upgrade exists. firebase-admin was raised to 14.3.0 on 2026-08-23 (the current latest) and still pins @google-cloud/storage 7.22.0, whose gaxios 6.7.1 depends on uuid 9.0.1. npm's only proposed remedy is firebase-admin@10.3.0, a major DOWNGRADE of three majors that would reintroduce years of fixed issues. Resolution requires firebase-admin to advance its @google-cloud/storage dependency upstream.
entries.reachability: Not reachable. GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq affects uuid v3/v5/v6 only, and only when the caller supplies a `buf` argument to write into. Verified in node_modules on 2026-08-23: the two consumers on this path call the unaffected v4 generator with no arguments at all — gaxios/build/src/gaxios.js:417 `uuid_1.v4()` and teeny-request/build/src/index.js:135 `uuid.v4()`. No GoalPlace code calls uuid directly. There is no code path, attacker controlled or otherwise, that reaches the vulnerable branch.
entries.mitigation: Vulnerable branch is unreachable (see reachability). Cloud Functions run server-side with no attacker-supplied buffer reaching uuid. Re-check on each firebase-admin release; the advisory clears as soon as the @google-cloud/storage chain moves to uuid >= 11.1.1.

entries.reason: Reached only through firebase-tools, a devDependency used for local emulators and deploys. firebase-tools was raised to 15.28.1 (current latest) on 2026-08-23 and still carries the chain; npm proposes firebase-tools@14.23.0, a major downgrade of the CLI.
entries.reachability: Not reachable. GHSA-w5hq-g745-h8pq affects uuid v3/v5/v6 only, and only when the caller supplies a `buf` argument to write into. Verified in node_modules on 2026-08-23: the two consumers on this path call the unaffected v4 generator with no arguments at all — gaxios/build/src/gaxios.js:417 `uuid_1.v4()` and teeny-request/build/src/index.js:135 `uuid.v4()`. No GoalPlace code calls uuid directly. There is no code path, attacker controlled or otherwise, that reaches the vulnerable branch. This copy is additionally never shipped: firebase-tools is a devDependency and is not part of any deployed artifact.
entries.mitigation: Not shipped to any runtime. Executed only on developer and CI machines running deploy commands. Clears when firebase-tools advances its gaxios dependency.

entries.reason: Reached only through firebase-tools' Pub/Sub emulator support. firebase-tools 15.28.1 is the current latest and still resolves @opentelemetry/core below 2.8.0; npm proposes firebase-tools@14.23.0, a major CLI downgrade.
entries.reachability: Not reachable in any deployed artifact. The advisory is unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation, which requires processing attacker-controlled baggage headers. This copy exists only inside firebase-tools, a devDependency; GoalPlace ships no OpenTelemetry instrumentation and no deployed service parses baggage headers through this package.
entries.mitigation: Not shipped. Runs only on developer and CI machines invoking the Firebase CLI, against local emulators rather than untrusted network input.
